description_en: Call the StartServiceInstance operation to start a service instance that is in the Stopped or StartFailed state
description_zh: 当服务实例状态为Stopped（已关机）、StartFailed（开机失败）时，调用StartServiceInstance接口启动服务实例
kebab_example: aliyun computenest start-service-instance --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-instance-id si-d6ab3a63ccbb4b170000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartServiceInstance

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value on your client. This value can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters long
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the service instance resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the service instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/396200.html operation to obtain the service instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
服务实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/396200.html获取服务实例ID
parameters.name: service_instance_id
